statements.quote: Revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2024 increased by 72% to $35.2 million from $20.5 million in the prior year period, and consisted of $13.9 million in Digital Assets Mining revenue, $9.0 million in Managed Services revenue, $3.4 million in High Performance Computing – Colocation and Cloud revenue, and $8.9 million in Other revenue.
statements.notes: The $3.4 million is High Performance Computing – Colocation and Cloud segment revenue (data-center/GPU-as-a-service) for the quarter ended June 30, 2024 only, not the full fiscal year. The segment name does not say AI explicitly, so treating it as data-center revenue is an interpretation.
